items.text: Race condition in wallet-top-up webhook processing + no idempotency key → send N concurrent webhook replays → credit account balance N times from a single real payment

Race condition in coupon redemption + coupon marked 'used' only after full request completes → fire 50 concurrent redemption requests → redeem a single-use 100%-off coupon dozens of times before lock catches up
Race condition in inventory decrement during checkout + no row-level lock → purchase more units of a limited-stock item than exist, then resell externally before the merchant notices the oversell

Race condition between 'delete payment method' and 'process pending charge' → cancel a card immediately after authorizing a large charge, causing the charge to process against a stale/deleted payment method reference and desync the ledger
Race condition in referral-reward crediting + self-referral not blocked at the database level → script parallel signups referring each other to mint unlimited referral credit
